card.name: Start of hypersensitivity and redistribution
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word in warnings, mostly "hypers" in "hypersensitivity" after severe, acute or immediate. Also "redistribution" in fat redistribution and "errone" in "erroneously".

modes.label: Hypersensitivity start
modes.description: The opening piece "hypers" of hypersensitivity after a severity or timing word.
modes.example: clinical evaluation of patients who experience immediate<< hypers>>ensitivity reactions while receiving ProAir Digih

modes.label: Fat redistribution
modes.description: The word "redistribution" in the HIV fat redistribution/accumulation warning.
modes.example: 5.8 Fat Redistribution In HIV-infected patients,<< redistribution>>/accumulation of body fat including central

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: The start of "erroneously" or the word "administration" after "In these patients,".
modes.example: The possibility of an<< errone>>ously elevated PT/INR result due

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
